name: token-counter
title: Token Counter
description: Counts BPE tokens for OpenAI-compatible encodings (cl100k_base, o200k_base) without building the token list.

usage.python:
from kura_rs import token_counter

n = token_counter.count("o200k_base", prompt)
assert n <= 128_000, f"prompt too long: {n} tokens"
